content.title: Where to Watch the Artemis II Splashdown Live
content.text: Skip to content Skip to content The Artemis II is set to splashdown on Earth later today and you can tune in. The Artemis II mission launched April 1. It is NASA’s first crewed flight beyond low-Earth orbit since the Apollo 17 mission in 1972. On April 7, NASA released the first photos taken of the far side of the moon, showcasing regions of Earth’s natural satellite that no human has seen before.
